item.title: Department of City Planning Proposed Street Number Rulemaking
item.description:
City Planning | Agency Rules | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-11-17
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning will hold a public hearing on Nov. 17, 2026, on its proposed rule for street numbering.

item.description:
City Planning Commission | Public Hearings and Meetings | Public Hearings | Hearing: 2026-10-28
In plain English (machine-written): The City Planning Commission will hold a public hearing on Oct. 28, 2026, according to this City Record notice.

item.title: 625 Madison Negative Declaration CEQR No. 26DCP157M
item.description:
City Planning | Special Materials | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning issued a negative declaration for a project at 625 Madison, finding it would have no significant environmental impact under City Environmental Quality Review (CEQR) reference 26DCP157M.

item.title: Notice of Completion for Park Avenue Brooklyn Rezoning Final Environmental Impact Statement (FEIS), CEQR No. 24DCP124K
item.description:
City Planning | Special Materials | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning has issued a notice that the final environmental impact statement for the Park Avenue Brooklyn rezoning, CEQR No. 24DCP124K, is complete.
